title: 第14章黑市
novel_title: 莫欺老年穷，一天增加一个天赋点
content_zh:
“陈爷爷！”秦婉儿的声音清脆如黄莺，“我让厨房做了些桂花糕，给你送些尝尝。你总吃那些糙米饭，对身子不好。”

    陈安脸上立刻堆起慈祥的笑容，接过食盒，浑浊的眼睛里满是感动：“哎哟，婉儿丫头有心了，快进来坐，快进来坐。”

    “不了不了，”秦婉儿摆摆手，回头推了一下身后的林枫，“林枫，快叫人。”

    林枫的眉头几不可查地一皱，似乎觉得这个举动毫无意义。

    但在秦婉儿的注视下，他还是极其敷衍地对陈安拱了拱手。

    “陈爷爷。”

    声音平淡，没有半分起伏，更谈不上丝毫敬意。

    陈安仿佛毫无所觉，依旧笑呵呵地应着。

    秦婉儿似乎也察觉到了气氛的尴尬，没再多留，拉着林枫的胳膊便转身告辞：“陈爷爷，那我们先走了，您记得趁热吃！”

    “好，好，路上慢点。”

    陈安目送着两人离去，缓缓关上了房门。

    屋门闭合的瞬间，他脸上的笑容便消失了。

    凭借远超常人的听力，院外两人的交谈声，清晰地传入他的耳中。

    是林枫的声音，带着毫不掩饰的不解与轻蔑。

    “婉儿，一个行将就木的糟老头子，有什么好看的？你把时间浪费在他身上，还不如多修炼半个时辰。师父给我的那颗百年老参，药力还没完全化开呢。”

    秦婉儿的声音立刻带上了压抑的怒气。

    “林枫！你怎么能这么说！陈爷爷是我爹的救命恩人，你现在享受的一切，都建立在这份恩情上！你必须尊重他！”

    “好好好，我错了，我道歉。”林枫的语气变得敷衍，“下次我注意。走了，王总镖头还在等我请教拳法。”

    脚步声渐行渐远。

    屋内，陈安静静地站着，脸上古井无波。

    他倒也没有觉得愤怒之类的，毕竟六十年的沉浮，早已让他明白，愤怒是弱者最无力的咆哮。

    这个世界，终究是靠力量说话的。

    秦婉儿的善意，很温暖。

    但这份温暖，能庇护他多久？

    今日有她维护，明日呢？
content_en:
"Grandpa Chen!" Qin Waner's voice was as clear as an oriole, "I asked the kitchen to make some sweet-scented osmanthus cakes and give you some to try. You always eat those brown rice, which is not good for your health."

    Chen An immediately put on a kind smile on his face, took the food box, his cloudy eyes were full of emotion: "Oh, Wan'er girl is interested, come in and sit down, come in and sit down."

    "No, no," Qin Waner waved her hand, turned around and pushed Lin Feng behind her, "Lin Feng, call someone quickly."

    Lin Feng's brows furrowed slightly, as if he felt that this move was meaningless.

    But under Qin Wan'er's gaze, he still bowed his hand to Chen An extremely perfunctorily.

    "Grandpa Chen."

    The voice was flat, without any fluctuation, let alone the slightest respect.

    Chen An didn't seem to notice anything and still responded with a smile.

    Qin Wan'er seemed to be aware of the awkward atmosphere. She didn't stay any longer. She took Lin Feng's arm and turned to leave: "Grandpa Chen, let's go first. Remember to eat it while it's hot!"

    "Okay, okay, slow down on the road."

    Chen An watched the two people leave and slowly closed the door.

    The moment the door closed, the smile on his face disappeared.

    With his hearing far beyond that of ordinary people, the sound of the conversation between the two people outside the hospital reached his ears clearly.

    It was Lin Feng's voice, with undisguised confusion and contempt.

    "Wan'er, what's so interesting about a rotten old man who is about to die? You're wasting your time on him, you might as well practice for half an hour more. The centuries-old ginseng my master gave me hasn't fully released its potency yet."

    Qin Wan'er's voice immediately took on suppressed anger.

    "Lin Feng! How can you say that! Grandpa Chen is my father's savior. Everything you enjoy now is based on this kindness! You must respect him!"

    "Okay, okay, I was wrong, I apologize." Lin Feng's tone became perfunctory, "I'll be more careful next time. Now that I'm gone, Mr. Wang, the bodyguard, is still waiting for me to ask for my boxing skills."

    The footsteps faded away.

    Inside the room, Chen Jing stood quietly, his face as calm as ever.

    He didn't feel angry at all. After all, sixty years of ups and downs had already made him understand that anger is the weakest roar of the weak.

    This world, after all, relies on strength to speak.

    Qin Wan'er's kindness is very warm.

    But how long can this warmth protect him?

    She protects you today, but what about tomorrow?
